procedure.instruction: Remove every prior application/profile copy using the platform procedure and verify the application data location is absent.
Install the exact recorded artifact without a release credential or manual configuration edit.
Cold-launch and complete the disclosed first-run identity and recovery-authority flow.

scenarios.expected: A fresh user reaches an ordinary ready state, sees accurate provider/mode disclosure, and is not shown a false stable or production claim.

procedure.instruction: Exchange a Connect code between two fresh identities without editing a route or address.
Complete the message-request or invitation consent flow and compare the displayed trust information.
Exchange a first message and retain timing for contact establishment and authenticated delivery.

scenarios.expected: Two fresh users establish consent and exchange an authenticated first message with honest queued, sent, and delivered states.

procedure.instruction: Receive an unknown-sender request and confirm it is separate from contacts and ordinary history.
Delete one request and confirm only the bounded replay tombstone remains.
Block another exact identity and confirm local queues/capabilities are removed without remote-deletion wording.

scenarios.expected: Unknown senders remain provisional and Accept, Delete, and Block have distinct, accurately described effects.

procedure.instruction: Receive a group invitation from an authenticated contact.
Inspect the bounded invitation without joining or downloading group media.
Exercise one accept and one reject path and inspect resulting membership/history.

scenarios.expected: Group membership is created only by explicit consent, and rejection does not create ordinary group history.

procedure.instruction: Take the receiving endpoint offline after contact establishment.
Send through a durable mailbox and record sender state after relay commit.
Reconnect the receiver, collect and commit the exact envelope, then observe the authenticated receipt.

scenarios.expected: The relay retains ciphertext until exact endpoint commit/ack; reconnect produces one visible message and one honest authenticated receipt.

procedure.instruction: Export a root-free backup and separately held offline recovery authority using throwaway qualification identities.
Restore onto a clean profile and verify a higher recovery epoch with one fresh device.
Verify eligible history/petnames remain, excluded live secrets do not, and contacts require honest re-verification/re-handshake.

scenarios.expected: Clean-device recovery preserves only declared portable state, revokes the former device set, and does not restore live rendezvous, ratchet, wake, group-chain, or delivery secrets.

procedure.instruction: Attempt to introduce a descendant from an older recovery epoch after a newer recovery.
Present conflicting recovery descendants without ordering one as authoritative.
Confirm both cases fail closed and surface a visible recovery conflict.

scenarios.expected: Old-epoch descendants and recovery forks are rejected visibly; no ordering rule silently selects authority.

procedure.instruction: Link an additional installation through scan, compare, confirm, and any required quorum approval.
Make one linked installation unavailable and revoke it with the remaining quorum.
Bring the revoked installation back and confirm its descendants, sync, rendezvous, wake, and delivery capabilities remain rejected.

scenarios.expected: Device authority follows the accepted manifest chain and revoked or old-epoch installations cannot resume authority.

procedure.instruction: Receive recognized, mismatched, unknown, and potentially active file types.
Confirm no attachment autoplays or opens and unsafe hints receive bounded warnings.
Exercise protected export/open and verify screen-reader labels and cancellation.

scenarios.expected: Attachments remain inert until an explicit protected action and are never described as malware-free or remotely erasable.

procedure.instruction: Place, answer, exchange audio, and end one call over a verified direct route.
Repeat with direct path unavailable and the declared supported relay/fallback path.
Blackhole the optional path and verify no false connected state or delivery-state change.

scenarios.expected: Call state and audio follow authenticated sessions; route failure is visible and does not relabel message delivery.

procedure.instruction: Background, lock, switch tasks, and capture the platform app-switcher/overview from sensitive screens.
Return through the configured lock gate and verify sensitive content is not exposed early.
Exercise the documented screenshot/screen-recording boundary and retain only synthetic content.

scenarios.expected: Sensitive content follows the declared platform protection boundary and limitations remain explicit.

procedure.instruction: Navigate onboarding, requests, conversation, groups, attachments, calls, recovery, modes, delivery states, and errors with the platform screen reader.
Confirm controls, headings, state changes, and destructive actions have unique meaningful labels.
Confirm new request, delivery, failure, call, and recovery-conflict changes are announced without exposing content on a locked surface.

scenarios.expected: Every critical flow is operable and understandable with the platform screen reader, with no content-only or color-only state.

procedure.instruction: Traverse each critical flow in logical focus order and confirm focus remains visible after dialogs and navigation.
Complete desktop flows using keyboard alone, including cancel and destructive confirmations.
Measure mobile interactive targets and exercise adjacent controls without accidental activation.

scenarios.expected: Critical actions have deterministic focus order, full keyboard access where applicable, and platform-sized touch targets.

procedure.instruction: Run critical flows at the largest supported text/display scale and inspect clipping, overlap, and hidden actions.
Exercise mixed-direction synthetic names/messages and verify controls and security identifiers remain unambiguous.
Enable reduced motion and high-contrast/dark settings and verify state remains perceivable.

scenarios.expected: Scaled and bidirectional text does not hide security decisions; contrast and reduced-motion settings preserve complete operation.

procedure.instruction: Background and lock the receiving device after contact establishment.
Deposit durable work and invoke only the configured bounded wake/collection opportunity.
Observe deadline handling, durable remainder, notification shape, and authenticated receipt after collection.

scenarios.expected: Background work is bounded, durable remainder survives, and wake never advances message delivery state.

procedure.instruction: Force-stop Android or force-quit iOS using the documented platform action.
Send while the application has no execution opportunity and observe optional wake behavior.
Relaunch manually and verify bounded collection of durable work with honest prior state.

scenarios.expected: The platform no-execution limitation is stated accurately and no message is lost or falsely marked delivered.

procedure.instruction: Deny visible notification permission and inspect advertised wake profiles.
Exercise ordinary direct/mailbox receipt while permission remains denied.
Restore permission and verify a fresh eligible capability generation without stale reuse.

scenarios.expected: Visible wake becomes ineligible when permission requires it; ordinary delivery remains functional.

procedure.instruction: Establish a conversation and queued work over Wi-Fi behind an ordinary NAT.
Move to cellular during active/queued work without restarting the identity or editing configuration.
Return to Wi-Fi and verify deduplication, route refresh, receipts, and call/message state.

scenarios.expected: Network handoff refreshes routes without identity change, duplicate history, lost durable work, or false delivery.

procedure.instruction: Enter Doze with the stock device locked and exercise normal-priority background wake.
Exercise high priority only with the exact static immediately visible notification.
Observe OEM/provider delay or deprioritization and verify ordinary mailbox/direct retry remains authoritative.

scenarios.expected: Android background restrictions remain honest, continuation is bounded, and optional wake failure never alters delivery semantics.

procedure.instruction: Disable Background App Refresh and confirm background-only eligibility is removed.
Exercise background and generic-visible APNs profiles with the required push type, priority, and collapse behavior.
Rotate the APNs token and verify old capability revocation without recording either token.

scenarios.expected: APNs is used directly without PushKit; platform limitations, token rotation, and static content-free payloads are accurately enforced.

procedure.instruction: Place two named physical clients behind separately administered ordinary IPv4 NATs.
Complete Standard first contact without manual address or configuration edits.
Exchange messages, offline mailbox delivery, and an audio call while recording route class and timings.

scenarios.expected: The clean-install golden path works across distinct ordinary NATs with honest fallback and delivery state.

procedure.instruction: Use two named endpoints with real IPv6 reachability and record the provider/network conditions.
Exercise contact, message, attachment, and call paths.
Remove the IPv6 path and verify bounded rediscovery/fallback without duplicate history.

scenarios.expected: IPv6 operation and failure preserve protocol semantics and bounded route selection.

procedure.instruction: Confirm one named endpoint is behind carrier-grade NAT and record the carrier without subscriber identifiers.
Exercise first contact, message, and offline mailbox delivery.
Exercise call setup and the declared relay/fallback result.

scenarios.expected: CGNAT limitations and fallback are measured on a real carrier path rather than inferred from a local namespace.

procedure.instruction: Record a real successful or failed DCUtR/hole-punch attempt across the named NAT pair.
Force the supported relay path and exchange message/call traffic.
Blackhole the relay and verify mailbox/queued fallback remains honest.

scenarios.expected: Direct and relay paths are distinguished; relay failure does not lose queued ciphertext or imply delivery.

procedure.instruction: Blackhole every disclosed default provider domain at both endpoints.
Observe bounded failure, status language, and retained queued work without busy loops.
Select an alternate route/operator and complete delivery without identity change.

scenarios.expected: Default-provider failure is visible and replaceable, with no mandatory-domain dependency.

procedure.instruction: Use a separately configured bootstrap path after the default is unavailable.
Replace directory, mailbox, and optional rendezvous/wake endpoints with qualified alternatives.
Complete first contact, offline delivery, recovery, and provider rotation.

scenarios.expected: No single provider is mandatory and replacement does not change identity, message format, trust, or delivery semantics.

procedure.instruction: Select Sovereign behavior with optional rendezvous and wake disabled.
Use user-selected DHT/bootstrap, mailbox, direct/LAN, QR/file, and self-hosted routes.
Complete contact, offline delivery, fallback, and recovery without a project-operated service.

scenarios.expected: Pure-core operation retains the same cryptographic trust and delivery meanings while optional services remain absent.

procedure.instruction: Restart a mailbox after durable deposit and during an active lease, then collect exactly once.
Reach declared item/byte/rate capacity and observe bounded uniform refusal without capacity disclosure.
Exercise expiry and duplicate acknowledgement while proving unrelated rows remain.

scenarios.expected: Durable rows survive restart, leases are idempotent, overload is bounded, and only exact acknowledged/expired rows disappear.

procedure.instruction: Blackhole rendezvous and wake, then remove every optional convenience service.
Use direct, DHT, durable mailbox, LAN, mesh, or carried-file routes that remain in the selected mode.
Restore optional services and verify coalesced refresh without duplicate history or authority change.

scenarios.expected: Optional-service loss reduces convenience only; identity, cryptographic trust, queued work, and ordinary fallback remain intact.

procedure.instruction: Attach two stock-firmware endpoint radios, disable every non-loopback internet/LAN route, and record board/firmware/region.
Pair two fresh test identities out of band with mesh-broadcast hints only.
Exchange PQXDH first message, authenticated delivered receipt, and ratcheted reply over RF.

scenarios.expected: Real stock radios carry only sealed Komms envelopes and complete a two-way authenticated exchange with no alternate network path.

procedure.instruction: Retain the content-free KOMMS_HIL_RESULT emitted by the real-radio harness.
Record exact handed/received frame counts and decoded/malformed aggregate counts for both endpoints.
Record radio-reported region/modem parameters, estimated airtime, and any pre-transmission duty-cycle refusals.

scenarios.expected: Measured frames and airtime are revision-bound; a duty-limited region refuses excess work before transmission rather than silently queueing it.

procedure.instruction: Add one stock-firmware repeater and physically isolate/attenuate endpoint radios so direct endpoint reception is independently ruled out.
Retain secret-free topology and Meshtastic routing evidence showing the repeater path.
Run the two-way E2EE harness and record frames, airtime, timings, failures, and retest disposition.

scenarios.expected: A real isolated multi-hop stock-radio route completes the same E2EE exchange without exposing message content to the mesh.

procedure.instruction: Configure one bounded bridge with a real radio side and a separately reachable durable mailbox/internet side.
Exchange sealed traffic mesh-to-internet and internet-to-mesh, including authenticated receipts.
Restart/blackhole each side and verify custody, deduplication, duty cycle, and unrelated rows remain correct.

scenarios.expected: The bridge forwards only sealed envelopes, obeys airtime and durable-custody limits, and does not become an identity or plaintext authority.
